policy: Air-gapped model integrity (invariant I5). Every entry pins an artifact that ships INSIDE the repository under assets/models/. The loader refuses any hash mismatch (fail-closed); there is no runtime download and no network path. An empty artifacts list means the deterministic fallback reasoner is the default enabled engine; the on-device model activates only via --features local-model after a real artifact is committed here with its pinned hash.

steps: 1. Obtain a quantized GGUF instruct model (target class: q4_k_m, <= 2 GB, strong structured-JSON compliance; candidate: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct GGUF, Apache-2.0) from its official distribution.
2. Copy the .gguf into assets/models/ (respect the repo file-size policy; chunk if needed).
3. Compute sha256 and add an entry to 'artifacts' with fileName, sha256Hex, declaredRamBudgetBytes (<= 2147483648).
4. Place the license text alongside as <fileName>.LICENSE.
5. Build the service with --features local-model and re-run scripts/phase23-adversarial-audit.py (model-hash gate must PASS).
